```{r}
library(A2iSimR, lib.loc = "R_library")
packageVersion("A2iSimR")
```

```{r}
p <- a2i_calibrated_params("HEK293T__joint_condition_primary")
f0 <- a2i_make_features(p, n_transcripts = 4000, n_sites = 10000, seed = 101)
```

```{r}
f <- f0                       # reset FIRST
n_reps       <- 8
strength     <- 1
adar_strength <- 0.5
adar_shift   <- 1
target_depth <- 100
phi          <- 50

# condition effects
for (cond in c("WT_IFNb", "ADAR1KO_mock", "ADAR1KO_IFNb",
               "ADAR1p150KO_mock", "ADAR1p150KO_IFNb")) {
  col <- paste0("de_logit_shift_condition", cond)
  f$site_info[[col]] <- strength * f0$site_info[[col]]
}

# ADAR modifier
p$design$modifier_effect_mode <- "full"
p$design$adar_sd["ADAR"] <- 1
f$site_info$modifier_active_ADAR <- f$site_info$editable
f$site_info$modifier_slope_ADAR  <- adar_strength * as.numeric(f$site_info$editable)
f$site_info$adar_sensitive       <- f$site_info$editable
p$design$adar_condition_shift[c("WT_mock", "WT_IFNb"), "ADAR"] <- c(0, adar_shift)

# sampling / depth
f$site_info$editing_sampling_model <- "beta_binomial"
f$site_info$precision <- phi
f$transcript_info$baseline_expr <- 1000
f$site_info$site_depth_multiplier <- target_depth / 1000
f$site_info$coverage_fraction <- f$site_info$site_depth_multiplier

p$design$lib_condition_scale[] <- 1
p$design$lib_sdlog <- 0
```

```{r}
sim <- a2i_simulate(p,
  transcript_info = f$transcript_info, site_info = f$site_info,
  n_per_condition = c(WT_mock = n_reps, ADAR1KO_mock = n_reps), seed = 102)

counts <- a2i_long_counts(sim)

# add the per-sample ADAR effect (16 values) to every row of that sample
counts$ADAR_effect_z <- sim$sample_info$ADAR_effect_z[
  match(counts$sample_id, sim$sample_info$sample_id)
]

# keep rows that actually have reads
counts   <- subset(counts,   editable & depth > 0)
counts$condition   <- factor(counts$condition,   levels = c("WT_mock", "ADAR1KO_mock"))


fit1 <- glm(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition,
            family = quasibinomial(), data = counts)
fit2 <- glm(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition + ADAR_effect_z,
            family = quasibinomial(), data = counts)
summary(fit2)
```


```{r}
#editing level per sample = total G reads / total reads over editable sites
ed <- subset(counts4, editable & depth > 0)

sample_edit <- aggregate(cbind(alt_count, depth) ~ sample_id, data = ed, FUN = sum)

sample_edit$editing <- sample_edit$alt_count / sample_edit$depth
```

```{r}
get_row <- function(name, fit1, fit2) {
  c1 <- coef(summary(fit1)); c2 <- coef(summary(fit2))
  cond <- grep("^condition", rownames(c1), value = TRUE)
  data.frame(comparison       = name,
             coefficient      = cond,
             beta1_cond_only  = c1[cond, "Estimate"],
             p_beta1_cond_only = c1[cond, "Pr(>|t|)"],
             beta1_with_ADAR  = c2[cond, "Estimate"],
             p_beta1_with_ADAR = c2[cond, "Pr(>|t|)"],
             beta2_ADAR       = c2["ADAR_effect_z", "Estimate"],
             se_beta2         = c2["ADAR_effect_z", "Std. Error"],
             p_beta2          = c2["ADAR_effect_z", "Pr(>|t|)"],
             dispersion       = summary(fit2)$dispersion)
}

res <- rbind(get_row("WT_mock vs ADAR1KO_mock", fit1,   fit2),
             get_row("WT_IFNb vs ADAR1KO_IFNb", fit1_2, fit2_2),
             get_row("WT_mock vs WT_IFNb",      fit1_3, fit2_3))
print(res, digits = 3)
```




# Per-site analysis: WT_mock vs ADAR1KO_mock

The global models above pool every site into one regression. Here the same two
models are fitted **separately for every editable site**, using the `counts`
object from the WT_mock vs ADAR1KO_mock simulation (`sim`), which already has
`ADAR_effect_z` attached and is filtered to `editable & depth > 0`.

For each site:

* `m_cond`: `cbind(alt, ref) ~ condition` (same as `fit1`)
* `m_full`: `cbind(alt, ref) ~ condition + ADAR_effect_z` (same as `fit2`)

P-values come from drop-in-deviance F-tests between nested models rather than
from the Wald t-tests in `summary()`. Many sites have zero G reads in every
ADAR1KO sample (complete separation); there the coefficient runs off towards
-20 and its Wald p-value is close to 1 even though the difference is huge.
The F-test does not have that problem. Coefficients at such sites are flagged
with `separation = TRUE` and should not be interpreted as effect sizes.

```{r}
# Column that identifies a site in a2i_long_counts() output - check names(counts)
site_col <- "site_id"
stopifnot(site_col %in% names(counts))
counts$site_key <- counts[[site_col]]

fit_one_site <- function(d, ko_level = "ADAR1KO_mock", min_reps = 2) {
  # need enough samples in both conditions, and at least one G read
  if (any(table(d$condition) < min_reps)) return(NULL)
  if (sum(d$alt_count) == 0) return(NULL)

  fit_q <- function(fml) suppressWarnings(
    glm(fml, family = quasibinomial(), data = d))
  m_cond <- fit_q(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition)
  m_adar <- fit_q(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ ADAR_effect_z)
  m_full <- fit_q(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition + ADAR_effect_z)

  term <- paste0("condition", ko_level)
  c1 <- coef(m_cond); c2 <- coef(m_full)
  if (anyNA(c2[c(term, "ADAR_effect_z")])) return(NULL)   # aliased -> skip

  p_F <- function(small, big)
    suppressWarnings(anova(small, big, test = "F")[2, "Pr(>F)"])
  is_wt <- d$condition != ko_level

  data.frame(
    site_key        = d$site_key[1],
    mean_depth      = mean(d$depth),
    edit_WT         = sum(d$alt_count[is_wt])  / sum(d$depth[is_wt]),
    edit_KO         = sum(d$alt_count[!is_wt]) / sum(d$depth[!is_wt]),
    beta1_cond_only = unname(c1[term]),
    p_cond_only     = p_F(update(m_cond, . ~ 1), m_cond),  # condition, no ADAR
    beta1_with_ADAR = unname(c2[term]),
    p_cond_adj      = p_F(m_adar, m_full),                 # condition | ADAR
    beta2_ADAR      = unname(c2["ADAR_effect_z"]),
    p_ADAR          = p_F(m_cond, m_full),                 # ADAR | condition
    dispersion      = summary(m_full)$dispersion,
    separation      = any(fitted(m_full) < 1e-8 | fitted(m_full) > 1 - 1e-8)
  )
}

# optional coverage filter, consistent with the site-level plot above
counts_site <- subset(counts, depth >= 10)

site_res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(counts_site, counts_site$site_key),
                                  fit_one_site))
rownames(site_res) <- NULL

# multiple-testing correction across sites
site_res$padj_cond_only <- p.adjust(site_res$p_cond_only, method = "BH")
site_res$padj_cond_adj  <- p.adjust(site_res$p_cond_adj,  method = "BH")
site_res$padj_ADAR      <- p.adjust(site_res$p_ADAR,      method = "BH")

nrow(site_res)                                   # sites tested
sum(site_res$separation)                         # sites with separation
colSums(site_res[, c("padj_cond_only", "padj_cond_adj", "padj_ADAR")] < 0.05)
summary(site_res$beta2_ADAR[!site_res$separation])
```

Per-site summary table, in the same spirit as `res` above:

```{r}
ok <- !site_res$separation
site_summary <- data.frame(
  n_sites                 = nrow(site_res),
  n_separation            = sum(!ok),
  n_sig_cond_only         = sum(site_res$padj_cond_only < 0.05),
  n_sig_cond_with_ADAR    = sum(site_res$padj_cond_adj  < 0.05),
  n_sig_ADAR              = sum(site_res$padj_ADAR      < 0.05),
  median_beta1_cond_only  = median(site_res$beta1_cond_only[ok]),
  median_beta1_with_ADAR  = median(site_res$beta1_with_ADAR[ok]),
  median_beta2_ADAR       = median(site_res$beta2_ADAR[ok]),
  median_dispersion       = median(site_res$dispersion)
)
print(site_summary, digits = 3)

write.csv(site_res, "per_site_WTmock_vs_ADAR1KOmock.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Plots

```{r}
site_res$sig_cond <- ifelse(site_res$padj_cond_adj < 0.05, "FDR < 0.05", "n.s.")
sig_cols <- c("FDR < 0.05" = "#C44E52", "n.s." = "grey70")

# 1. WT vs KO editing per site
p_site_scatter <- ggplot(site_res, aes(edit_WT * 100, edit_KO * 100, colour = sig_cond)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sig_cols) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Editing in WT_mock (%)", y = "Editing in ADAR1KO_mock (%)",
       colour = NULL, title = "Per-site editing, WT vs ADAR1KO (mock)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# 2. Volcano plot for the condition effect (adjusted for ADAR)
#    separated sites are capped at -5 on the x axis and drawn as triangles
site_res$beta1_plot <- pmax(site_res$beta1_with_ADAR, -5)
p_volcano <- ggplot(site_res, aes(beta1_plot, -log10(padj_cond_adj),
                                  colour = sig_cond, shape = separation)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sig_cols) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 17)) +
  labs(x = "beta1: log-odds ADAR1KO vs WT (capped at -5)",
       y = "-log10 FDR", colour = NULL, shape = "Separation",
       title = "Per-site condition effect (adjusted for ADAR)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# 3. Distribution of the per-site ADAR coefficient
p_beta2 <- ggplot(subset(site_res, !separation), aes(beta2_ADAR)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#4C72B0", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "beta2: ADAR_effect_z (log-odds per SD)", y = "Number of sites",
       title = "Per-site ADAR effect") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# 4. How much does adjusting for ADAR change the condition effect?
p_attenuation <- ggplot(subset(site_res, !separation),
                        aes(beta1_cond_only, beta1_with_ADAR)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "beta1, condition only", y = "beta1, with ADAR_effect_z",
       title = "Condition effect before vs after ADAR adjustment") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

# 5. P-value histograms (should be flat + spike near 0)
p_pvals <- ggplot(
  rbind(data.frame(test = "condition | ADAR", p = site_res$p_cond_adj),
        data.frame(test = "ADAR | condition", p = site_res$p_ADAR)),
  aes(p)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, boundary = 0, fill = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ test) +
  labs(x = "p-value", y = "Number of sites", title = "Per-site p-values") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```

Optional: since the data are simulated, compare the per-site estimates with the
true per-site values stored in `sim$site_info` (check `names(sim$site_info)` if
the site ID column has a different name).

```{r}
truth <- sim$site_info[, c(site_col, "de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_mock",
                           "modifier_slope_ADAR")]
names(truth) <- c("site_key", "true_cond_shift", "true_ADAR_slope")
site_truth <- merge(site_res, truth, by = "site_key")

# recovery of the condition effect (non-separated sites)
with(subset(site_truth, !separation),
     cor(beta1_with_ADAR, true_cond_shift))

# power / false positives at FDR 5 %
table(called = site_truth$padj_cond_adj < 0.05,
      true_effect = site_truth$true_cond_shift != 0)

p_truth <- ggplot(subset(site_truth, !separation),
                  aes(true_cond_shift, beta1_with_ADAR)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "True logit shift (ADAR1KO_mock)", y = "Estimated beta1",
       title = "Per-site estimate vs simulated truth") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
p_truth
```




```{r}
s <- site_res$site_key[which.min(site_res$p_cond_adj)]   # most significant site
d <- subset(counts_site, site_key == s)
d$logit_edit <- qlogis((d$alt_count + 0.5) / (d$depth + 1))

m <- glm(cbind(alt_count, ref_count) ~ condition + ADAR_effect_z,
         family = quasibinomial(), data = d)
grid <- expand.grid(condition = levels(d$condition),
                    ADAR_effect_z = seq(min(d$ADAR_effect_z), max(d$ADAR_effect_z), length.out = 50))
grid$fit <- predict(m, newdata = grid)          # on the logit scale

ggplot(d, aes(ADAR_effect_z, logit_edit, colour = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = grid, aes(y = fit)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_cols) +
  labs(x = "ADAR_effect_z (per sample)", y = "Editing (log-odds)",
       title = paste("Site", s)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```
